productionTraining.title: Mechanical faults in rotating machinery dataset (normal, unbalance, misalignment, looseness)
productionTraining.acquisition: 20 independently reset physical tests, 5 per condition; 4 accelerometers; 25 kHz; approximately 1238 RPM
productionTraining.use: Production classifier training and whole-test held-out validation
productionTraining.changes: Deterministic 8,192-sample windows and RotorNote 48-feature vectors derived from selected raw recordings.

bearingBoundaryEvaluation.title: Vibration Data for Axial Ball Bearings and Spall Faults
bearingBoundaryEvaluation.acquisition: Single axial-vibration channel; 25.6 kHz; 30 seconds; 500 RPM; healthy and artificially seeded inner/outer race spalls.
bearingBoundaryEvaluation.use: External bearing-distress boundary evaluation only; never production training.
